verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that explicitly covers point-of-sale. Clean Markdown versions of the in-person payments docs (e.g. point-of-sale.md, tap-to-pay.md, refund-payment.md) are also served, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable documentation. Machine-readable OpenAPI definitions on GitHub add to this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs effectively, evidence of how deep the llms.txt content is (e.g. a full-content variant or agent-specific usage guidance), and an OpenAPI spec served from the docs host (probed paths returned 404).
